The Chinese characters for Lawrence

As a transliteration, Lawrence is usually written 劳伦斯 (Láo lún sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

劳
Láo
labor, toil
伦
lún
human relations, ethics
斯
sī
this (transliteration)

Origin and meaning

Lawrence comes from Latin and means “from Laurentum, laurel”.

About the name Lawrence

Saint Lawrence was a third-century Roman deacon and martyr.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Lawrence suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
